name: Metabob MCP
description: MCP bridge and local CPG analysis vessel. Exposes Metabob analysis capabilities to AI agents via MCP (stdio) and to the activity system via HTTP resolver. Complements metabob-analysis-api: the analysis-api owns persistent problem storage and server-side CPG; this vessel owns the agent interface and local in-process CPG inference (co-change prediction, impact traversal).

tools.name: init_workspace
tools.description: Parse workspace files into the local CPG index. Run before predict_cochanges or analyze_impact.

tools.name: get_problems
tools.description: Fetch code problems from the analysis server ranked by severity and impact.

tools.name: search_codebase
tools.description: Semantic search over the indexed codebase using natural language.

tools.name: predict_cochanges
tools.description: Predict co-changing files/components using local GCN embeddings. No API call required.

tools.name: analyze_impact
tools.description: Traverse the local CPG to find downstream dependents of changed files.

tools.name: annotate_component
tools.description: Attach design decisions, notes, or warnings to a code component.

tools.name: mark_complete
tools.description: Mark a problem as resolved with optional commit reference.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Project-level code health metrics and summary statistics.

notes: MCP stdio transport is separate from the HTTP vessel server — both start in the same process.
Set METABOB_API_KEY and METABOB_ENDPOINT (or metabob.apiKey / metabob.endpoint in ~/.metabob/config.json) to attach to a substrate; nothing has a default.
Set METABOB_API_KEY for authenticated API calls; the vessel server validates incoming requests against the same key.
init_workspace must be called before predict_cochanges or analyze_impact — local CPG is in-process only.
WORKSPACE_PATH defaults to cwd; set it if the agent's cwd differs from the repo root.
